author: jpep
content:
I'm sorry, I really don't understand what I did to cause this? 

I came into sunshine hut and politely asked for info regarding a couple things. I didn't ask anyone to decomp the game, I was simply curious if the modding scene, which has a lot of technical knowledge about the game, would know precise, technical info about them. 
I was given an approximate response, which was nice of Wade but unhelpful since i was specifically asking for TECHNICAL info, and had worded it so. Then, I was told to "just ask other speedrunners shrug". Which, yes? I do think that is rude? I would not have been asking a modding discord if the speedrunning discord knew anything about it. Besides, I am a top level sunshine runner, and I found it irritating that the person I was talking to seemed to be presuming I had not done any basic research or was not knowledgeable about the game.

author: jpep
content: As for how other people spoke about the interaction, I do not really have control over that, but I will point you to this message, in which I actively explained that it was a singular "meh" message. I really do not think this is a big indictment.
